_comment: Was TRANSFORM_HERO (Arakni's agent-of-chaos effect). 'Transform up to 3 ash into Aether AshwingS' is PLURAL: each ash becomes its own Ashwing, so each=true. Passing all three to one transform would stack them under a single Ashwing -- a different board state, and strictly worse for the player. 'Up to' means fewer than 3 is fine.
